subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Liyue Harbor wharf and meet Chief Mate Juza

700300101.text: Hey, hey, Traveler! Long time no see, you been keeping well?

700300103.text: Oh, uh... So, you've completely forgotten who I am, huh?

700300104.text: I'm Juza, chief mate of The Alcor! You hitched a ride with us to Inazuma, in case you'd forgotten.

700300105.text: #Nah, {F#she's}{M#he's} just kidding with you, Juza! Of course we remember you, hehe.

700300106.text: Ah... I was gonna say! This is The Alcor we're talking about here, and I'm the chief mate to boot...

700300107.text: Yes, heh, so... you need a hand with anything?

700300108.text: Not me, actually. It's Kaedehara Kid, a temporary crew member of ours.

700300109.text: You know him, right? He came back with us on the return trip from Inazuma.

700300110.text: I don't know what's been going on with him, but he was in really high spirits the whole way back. He kept trying to get everyone to join him for some poetry and song.

700300111.text: Unfortunately, no one on board from Captain Beidou to Little Yue has that kind of um... Kind of, y'know, uh...

700300113.text: Sophistication! Yes! Not an ounce of the stuff between us.

700300116.text: So, once we got to Liyue, he disembarked and disappeared off into mother nature. I'm gonna say he probably couldn't bear being around a bunch of uncouth sailors a second longer.

700300117.text: Then, not long after that, we got a message from him telling us to keep an eye out for you.

700300119.text: Didn't give the specifics. He just said that if we saw you, we should tell you he wants to chat with you.

700300120.text: From the tone of the message, it didn't sound all that serious — but then again, who'd be asking for the likes of you unless it was some sort of major crisis?

700300121.text: #Actually, we deal with little things all the time, don't we, {NICKNAME}?

700300115.text: No, no! I mean sophistication! We don't have an ounce of the stuff between the whole crew.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the northern section of Liyue Harbor and look for Kazuha

700300301.text: You've returned, even before the wind could bring tidings of your progress. This is quite astonishing... How did you achieve it?

700300302.text: #Hehe, maybe {F#she's}{M#he's} got a few more tricks up {F#her}{M#his} sleeve than you thought!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the northern section of Liyue Harbor and look for Kazuha

700300201.text: While the bridge slowly withers, the strings gently whisper / A twilight melody from the solitary zither...

700300202.text: Hey, hey! Kaedehara Kid! So what are you up to here? We've come to help!

700300203.text: You made it. Good to see you again.

700300204.text: This appellation, "Kaedehara Kid"... When uttered by Paimon, it takes on a whole new tone.

700300205.text: Hee-hee, Paimon learned it from Chief Mate Juza.

700300208.text: Haha, what makes you say that? Do I usually mope around as if perpetually hounded by adverse fate?

700300209.text: It's 'cause Juza said that you needed us for something! We didn't expect to find you admiring the scenery and reciting poetry without a care in the whole world!

700300210.text: The events of Inazuma are behind me, and no longer linger on my mind. Now, I return to Liyue. It is the natural time to explore all the verses and melodies that arise from this land.

700300211.text: As to the matter requiring your assistance — there was none to begin with. Unfortunately, you are too late for that, because now, there is.

700300212.text: Huh? That was really confusing... There was none to begin with, but somehow now there still is...? What!?

700300213.text: Have you been eating those wild plants that you're not supposed to? 'Cause you're talking total baloney!

700300216.text: Wow... Well, Paimon thinks you play just like another bard we know, who plays for loose change.

700300217.text: Oh, you're friends with a professional bard? I hope I have the chance to meet them some day. Traveler, what do you think?

subQuests.subQuestName: Search for the Glaze Lilies required to repair the Ancient Zither

700300401.text: Good, these are fine specimens. They will be plenty. If we extract the juices and apply them to the body of the instrument, it should awaken from its present slumber.

700300402.text: Yes, there it is, that familiar feeling. It's awoken.

700300403.text: #Come, try it for yourself, {NICKNAME}. It's all yours.

700300405.text: Haha, can a poet not be forthright in expression? Then, let me rephrase. This instrument is my gift unto you.

700300406.text: I came back to Liyue to listen to what this region of the world has to say. In these vast and ancient lands watched over by the Geo Archon, there are countless soft voices to be heard... This gives me all the satisfaction I desire.

700300407.text: Of course, should there come a day when you wish to part with this instrument, I will come to collect it. But... I hope that day will never come.

700300408.text: Well, my onward journey beckons. What is the customary Liyue saying at moments like this? Ah, yes.
